findings.text: Every test passes --target tmp_path/skills; no test exercises the default destination (TARGET="$HOME/.gemini/config/skills" in the .sh, Join-Path $baseHome ".gemini\config\skills" in the .ps1). A regression to the wrong default path (the very upstream bug #633 this bridge exists for, ~/.gemini/antigravity/skills) would pass every test; a HOME/USERPROFILE-overridden run is absent.

Tests compare the destination to whatever dist/skills contains (_bundle_skills()), never to 26 or a pinned list. The skill count is only visible in the script's printed 'Copied N skills' message, which no test asserts.

Every copy/symlink/replace test calls _bundle_skills(), which pytest.skip()s when dist/skills is not built, and the runners skip when bash/pwsh is absent. The core AC checks silently become skips if the bundle is not built before the test run.

findings.ac: AC3 Antigravity discovers all copied skills
findings.text: No automated assertion or documented manual-verification step; the only proxy is that each dest/<name>/SKILL.md exists. Antigravity listing is unverified and no README or doc text for the bridge exists in the snapshot (grep of README for antigravity-bridge or gemini/config returns nothing).

_symlinks(dest) scans only the destination, and the bundle source contains no symlinks, so the preserve-symlink path of cp -r / Copy-Item is not exercised. Only a script that actively creates links (ln -s, New-Item SymbolicLink) would fail the test.

findings.ac: Overview / Track D optional plugin manifest
findings.text: Overview and the design doc's Track D contract name an optional plugin manifest into ~/.gemini/config/plugins/stratosphere-os. Neither script nor test implements or asserts it; it is marked optional, so non-blocking.
